answer: A farm cannot fake the aggregate without controlling every key it names, and therefore paying the juniper bond on all of them and exposing each to the walnut slash. Because the echo audit verifies the aggregate, a single forged member invalidates the whole batch. Attestations are aggregated into one signature over 16 distinct keys, and the aggregate must verify against each key's registered public value. The deposit is 56 dollars a seat. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
